page: Google Cloud Platform ct5p-hightpu-1t is a specialized accelerator-optimized server instance belonging to the ct5p family. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 112.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.15 GB per vCPU. The primary hardware accelerator is a single Google TPU v5p with 95 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM.

This configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The low system memory allocation relative to the high vCPU count represents a design tradeoff, prioritizing raw TPU acceleration and compute density over large-scale in-memory host processing.

The ct5p-hightpu-1t is engineered for workloads that heavily leverage TPU acceleration, such as large language model training, deep learning inference, and complex data science pipelines. The qualitative cost efficiency of this instance is driven by the integration of a dedicated Google TPU v5p, which provides high-density matrix math capabilities relative to general-purpose host resources.
